assistent_anleitung_mail_titel: Where do I get the access key?
assistent_anleitung_mail_schritt_1: Open API Keys at Resend and sign in.
assistent_anleitung_mail_schritt_2: Create a new key with a name and permission to send emails.
assistent_anleitung_mail_schritt_3: Copy the key immediately: You will not be able to view it later.
assistent_anleitung_mail_schritt_4: Paste the key into the protected field on this page.
assistent_anleitung_mail_schritt_5: Enter a sender address using your own domain verified with Resend. Add and verify your domain under Domains.
assistent_anleitung_mail_erfolg: How do I know it works? After “Send test email”, a success message appears; also check your inbox.
assistent_anleitung_mail_sicherheit: The key is never displayed in plain text.
assistent_anleitung_stripe_titel: Where do I get the keys?
assistent_anleitung_stripe_schritt_1: Open the API keys page in the Stripe Dashboard and select your sandbox or test mode.
assistent_anleitung_stripe_schritt_2: Copy the secret test key (starts with sk_test_) and paste it into the first protected field on this page.
assistent_anleitung_stripe_schritt_3: Open the Webhooks tab in Workbench. Create an event destination using the webhook address displayed on this page and the payment events listed here.
assistent_anleitung_stripe_schritt_4: Then copy the signing secret (starts with whsec_) from the webhook settings and paste it into the second protected field. It is not an API key.
assistent_anleitung_stripe_lokal: If the platform only runs on your computer, use the Stripe CLI: “stripe listen” outputs the signing secret.
assistent_anleitung_stripe_erfolg: How do I know it works? After “Test connection”, a success message appears. Whether actual notifications arrive can only be checked with the first test payment.
assistent_anleitung_stripe_sicherheit: Use only test keys here. Real payments are not yet enabled in this version.
